messages:
deploybot: DeployBot scheduled v2 rollout window 2026-03-25T02:00Z -> 2026-03-25T04:00Z. Sequence: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Operators: @mike @sara. Pinlist: /deploybot/pins/3923456789. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v2-rollout. Use `deploybot rollback v2` to rollback.

mike: ack. Quick ask — staging showed a small 4xx bump around header changes last night. Can we gate the first slice until we confirm header sanitize patch is applied?

sara: saw ~0.8% 422s in staging after the streaming header tweak. Not huge but risky for mobile clients. Prefer to hold 10% until nginx patch lands and we smoke test.

jo: telemetry matches sara. The spike correlates with mixed-case `X-RD-Client` header submissions from some older SDKs. Patch is ready (small nginx map) and tested in staging. Recommend deploy before the 10% step.

alex: proposal: hold the 10% step, deploy header-fix during the first 30m of the window, then run a 30m smoke. Proceed only if 5m rolling error rate <0.5% and p95 latency within baseline. Rollback triggers: 5m error rate >2% OR p95 latency >2x baseline OR >1% new 4xx from known client cohorts.

lina: I will update the release notes and SDK migration note to call out header case-insensitivity. Adding client snippet and the rollback criteria to docs PR.

sara: nginx snippet we used in staging — small map to normalize and default unknown when header missing:
```
map $http_x_rd_client $rd_client {
  default $http_x_rd_client;
  ""    "unknown";
}
proxy_set_header X-RD-Client $rd_client;
```

deploybot: Noted. Holding 10% step. Revised schedule: 02:00-02:30 UTC -> deploy header-fix to edge/proxy fleet, quick smoke 02:35-03:05 UTC, then proceed to 10% if smoke passes. Pinlist unchanged.

opsbot: smoke run started on staging. Initial metrics: cpu/mem OK, 422s trending down. Will post telemetry snapshot at 02:45 UTC.

mike: proceeding to 10% after ops confirm. Ops: monitor rolling 5m windows and be ready to execute `deploybot rollback v2` on incident.

jo: note for rollback: ensure fallback lane (v1-compatible model variant) is warmed in EU nodes — I patched warmup earlier today.

lina: release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4822 — added header normalize sample, SDK callouts, and rollback criteria.

alex: final: sequence agreed, ops on-call @sara will watch until 04:30 UTC. If any of the rollback triggers hit, execute rollback and post a brief incident note here. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
